newsitem.title: USA: IMF approves 3-year $131 mln loan for Haiti reform.
newsitem.headline: IMF approves 3-year $131 mln loan for Haiti reform.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund said Friday it approved a $131 million, three-year credit for Haiti under the enhanced structural adjustment facility to support the government's economic reform program for 1996-99.
Disbursement starts November 5, it said in a release.

The program aims to boost real GDP growth to 4.5 percent, cut inflation to under 10 percent form 20 percent in 1995/96, hold the external current account deficit to around 15 percent of GDP and boost net reserves to the equivalent of 2.7 months of imports from just over two months now, it said.
It plans to do this by broadening the tax base and strengthening the tax system while cutting government spending and adopting appropriate monetary and credit policies.
